initial.name: creator_prepare
initial.description: Prepare the expected effect and usage before implementing a new Creator design. Visible UI additions inspect live extension locations and PAUSE until the user confirms a complete layout in the placement panel, including with Search first off. Respect the returned selected region and slots. A cancelled or preview-only preparation does not authorize implementation. With Search first on, also search configured plugin indexes; follow nextAction to compare candidates or implement directly. Does not install plugins.

previewOnly.description: Set true only when the user explicitly requests a read-only preview without choosing or implementing. Return the preview then stop. Omit during normal plugin development, which waits for a UI placement decision.

outcome.description: In the user’s language, briefly describe the finished capability and expected output. For UI requests, describe behavior without fixing the location before the human chooses it. State access or persistence limits relevant to its use.

usage.description: In the user’s language, explain where to start and one concrete interaction, e.g. ask “搜索 B 站的 Vue 教程” to receive video links in the conversation.

query.description: Primary capability keyword, e.g. notes. Avoid combining implementation requirements into one query.

alternatives.description: Alternative short queries, including synonyms and the user’s language, e.g. 笔记 and 便签. Search independently and merge results; at most 2 alternatives.

indexes.description: Optional configured index URLs to search, at most 3. Omit for the first configured sources. Use omitted sources only when the user asks to expand discovery.

location.description: Required for visible UI additions. Reads the live extension-map plugin before showing the proposed region. Omit for tool-only, mode or service capabilities without a new visual surface; do not invent a panel.

impact.description: For UI requests, explain the user-visible change and affected neighbors in the user’s language.

initial.name: ui_extension_map
initial.description: Show a read-only, interactive map of UI extension slots actually declared by connected DSH pages, plus public theme tokens and theme configuration fields. Use for visible interface additions or when the user asks where DSH can be extended. It does not install, register UI, search markets, or require a choice. Omit region for an overview; set a region to suggest conservative entry/body locations. Declarations and occupants do not prove that a slot is currently visible; inspect exact slot props before coding. No declaration does not establish impossibility outside the application document.

region.description: Requested part of the window; overview lists all declarations.
